mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, the combination signals a highly accommodative monetary policy in a weak labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with weak labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A steady decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% over three months signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE declines by > 0.3% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST MoM > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is growing at a rate of more than 2% year-over-year and real final sales (RSAFS) are also growing at a rate of more than 2% year-over-year, the combination signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO YoY > 2% and RSAFS YoY > 2%.
